digest.component_or_area: prompt-cache ineffectiveness warning in structured LLM run path
propositions: The cache-ineffective warning fires on zero/zero cache counters without a lower token bound, so it false-alarms on prompts below the 4096-token cacheable floor where zero caching is expected.

The warning cannot distinguish a model silently failing to cache a cacheable prompt (real defect) from a sub-floor prompt that could never cache (expected), producing ~20 benign lines per review-plan run.
The observed opus/sonnet zero/zero readings are a direct-Anthropic-path artifact; Bedrock caching demonstrably works with cache_write_tokens > 0 on the same review.
The fix gates the warning on input_tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and single-sources the constant in capabilities.py, consumed by both pass1.py and structured_run.py.
Above-floor zero/zero cases still emit the warning, preserving detection of the genuine silent-cache defect while the operator-attested live-run acceptance criterion remains outstanding.
